why_it_fails: The step written as Ivo's own is a restart an agent with access to the build machine does in seconds: it needs no sign-in or press only Ivo can give, so naming it his step leaves him work an action should carry.

card.title: Restart the nightly build so tonight's test copy is fresh?
card.context: The nightly build that refreshes the test copy of the schedule data stopped yesterday. Until it restarts, tests run against data a day old and may miss a broken change.
card.question: Should the nightly build be restarted now?

choices.label: Yes, restart it
choices.cons: the build machine is busy for ten minutes

choices.label: Leave it until Monday
choices.effect: tests use day-old data over the weekend
choices.cons: a broken change may slip through

card.why: Ten minutes of a busy machine is cheap next to a missed broken change.
card.after_press: You restart it with the steps; the check sees the build running.

owner_step.label: Restart the nightly build
steps: Open the build server's page and sign in.
Open a terminal on the build machine and run the restart command for the nightly build.
Wait for it to say started.
